note: Recorded under records/ rather than as a code header, because Amendment 5 A5.1 freezes a family's code at its first D outcome, so r4/family_c.py cannot change after the run. The declaration of record is the final reviewed code commit c8f5849f (draft 5).

data_quality.note: The zero-volume rule (draft 5, fixed before any count on D) was binding: every incomplete window on D holds a zero-volume bar. Opus N1 count is 0, so no floored row entered any loss.

diagnostics.4h_and_1d_failures: At 4h, QLIKE against persistence fails on ADAUSDT, AVAXUSDT and DOTUSDT in all three models (statistics -0.18 to -0.96). In each of the 9 failing (model, coin) pairs the largest differential row is the window 2025-10-10 20:00 UTC (the October 10 liquidation crash), with realised variance 1,452 to 1,983 times the forecast and a differential of +447 to +617 against totals of -113 to -439. Without that one window the sums are -714 to -891 (DM statistics -6.6 to -8.2). This counterfactual is descriptive: the declared verdict stands, it is a real market event and not a data defect, and no re-run is licensed. At 1d, three or four coins fail per model (AVAXUSDT, DOGEUSDT and DOTUSDT in all three, BNBUSDT in C_LHAR-CJ_1d), with failing DM p from 0.051 to 0.340, and DOGEUSDT's 80% coverage is 0.770 and 0.778 in C_LHAR_1d and C_LHAR-X_1d. The 1d configurations are untrained for their first 8 folds on every coin (8 per coin, 80 coin-folds per model).
diagnostics.finalist_dm_long_lag: Every finalist test also passes at the descriptive 10-calendar-day lag (largest p_long 0.0023), so the gated lag-1 result does not rest on the lag choice.
diagnostics.evidence: Local copies in .superpowers/sdd/round4/family-c-results/: family_c_report.json, refit_comparison.json, counts.json, outliers.json (tools/fc-outliers.py, run in the c8f5849f image with --network none) and receipts/ (chain.log, mem.log and every receipt.json).

consequences: C_LHAR-X_1h is the family C forecast finalist. Its H read waits for its finalist lock, signed by the owner, and M's rule that all finalist locks are committed and signed before the first H read, with the reads in one batch.
The finalist may be used as the family C filter (M's dimension) only as declared in a later family's own declaration, which discloses that it follows this result.

The no-refit twin used one reserve slot (ledger +1). The refit comparison is descriptive: twin minus finalist QLIKE +0.0147, 90% interval [0.0041, 0.0329], so monthly refitting helped on D, which cannot authorize live refitting under M.
The 4h and 1d configurations are reported, not validated.
